purpose: HELD-OUT evaluation. The directed extractor was tuned on 13 AML candidates; this measures whether that tuning generalizes to a disease it never saw.
headline_finding: The directed extractor did NOT generalize. On held-out Glioblastoma its precision is 3/9 = 0.33, statistically indistinguishable from the lexical gate's 5/15 = 0.33, while its recall is WORSE (3/5 vs 5/5). The 4/4 scored on the AML tuning set was overfitting to 13 examples.
conclusion: Rule-based extraction tuned on 13 examples does not transfer. Do not merge these edges and do not ship the directed extractor as a precision improvement. Getting driver_of at usable precision needs a biomedical relation-extraction model or a substantially larger labeled set.

adjudication.pmid_sentence: A targetable PRR11-DHODH axis drives ferroptosis- and temozolomide-resistance in glioblastoma.
adjudication.note: Directed causal claim. Caveat: drives RESISTANCE, not oncogenesis itself.

adjudication.pmid_sentence: DRD2 signaling promotes glioblastoma (GBM) stem-like cells and GBM growth by activating MET.
CD38 overexpression drives glioblastoma progression via L1CAM/ICAM1/JAK-STAT-Driven tumor microenvironment rewiring.
our study demonstrated the oncogenic roles of HMGCR in glioblastoma cells and HMGCR might be a promising therapeutic target.
adjudication.note: FALSE NEGATIVE for directed. 'might' hedges the therapeutic-target clause, not the demonstrated oncogenic role. Clause-scoping of hedges is missing.

adjudication.pmid_sentence: Oncogenic potential of PIK3CD in glioblastoma is exerted through cytoskeletal proteins PAK3 and PLEK2.
adjudication.note: FALSE NEGATIVE for directed. 'potential' here means capacity, not author hedging.

adjudication.pmid_sentence: PRL-3 ... promotes glioblastoma progression by enhancing MMP7 through the ERK and JNK pathways.
adjudication.note: MMP7 is the downstream effector; the predicate's subject is PRL-3.

adjudication.pmid_sentence: Half of the eluate was DNase I digested for mRNA expression analysis ... for the genes estrogen receptor 1 (ESR1), progesterone receptor (PGR), v-...
adjudication.note: WORST FALSE POSITIVE. A METHODS sentence with no claim at all. 'oncogene' appears in a gene name later in the sentence. LCA scope is far too permissive on long sentences.

adjudication.pmid_sentence: CREB1-induced miR-1204 promoted malignant phenotype of glioblastoma through targeting NR3C2.
adjudication.note: INVERSION. NR3C2 is the miRNA's target being suppressed - a tumour-suppressor role. Opposite of driver_of.

adjudication.pmid_sentence: MED12 is overexpressed in glioblastoma patients and serves as an oncogene by targeting the VDR/BCL6/p53 axis.
adjudication.note: WRONG SUBJECT. MED12 is the oncogene; VDR sits in the targeted axis.

adjudication.pmid_sentence: Integrative analysis of small non-coding RNAs predicts a piRNA/miRNA-CCND1/BRAF/HRH1/ATXN3 regulatory circuit that drives oncogenesis in glioblastoma.
adjudication.note: COMPUTATIONAL PREDICTION ('predicts'), and HRH1 is one of five circuit members. 'predicts' is not in HEDGE_CUES.

adjudication.pmid_sentence: We further determined whether genetic or pharmacological targeting of InsR affected oncogenic functions of glioblastoma in vitro and in vivo.
adjudication.note: INTERROGATIVE FRAME. 'determined whether' states a question, not a finding.

adjudication.pmid_sentence: The Role of ACE I/D Polymorphism in Glioblastoma Pathogenesis: A Study on the Turkish Population.
adjudication.note: TITLE naming a topic of study, not asserting a result.

adjudication.pmid_sentence: We implemented SHERLOCK for the detection of BCR::ABL1 mRNA, a hallmark of chronic myeloid leukemia (CML), and EGFR DNA oncogenic alleles, frequently detected in glioblastoma...
adjudication.note: Assay-development sentence. ABL1 belongs to the CML clause; the glioblastoma clause is about EGFR.

adjudication.pmid_sentence: our study provides preliminary evidence of some causal relationship between ADRB1-targeted BBs and glioblastoma development.
adjudication.note: Both correct. Hedged and about beta-blockers, not ADRB1 itself.

adjudication.pmid_sentence: Abnormal promoter methylation and histone modifications were associated with differential expression of miRNAs in glioblastoma...
adjudication.note: Both correct. No driver predicate bound to DNMT3A.
